title: Engineer Level Dispatched to an Onsite Service Visit on TimeBank Hours
content:
**Service dispatch level schedule.** The block hours of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours service visit on a ticket opened in the security concern category are figured at the block's architect ratio, the desk dispatching its security architect; those of a visit on any other ticket the desk reprioritized to P1 after opening, at the senior engineer ratio, the desk dispatching a senior engineer to escalated work; those of any other service visit, at the technician ratio. The draw records that level.

The category is the one the ticket was opened in and a reprioritisation is a reprioritised milestone of the ticket that sets P1, both as the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history shows them.

| Visit's ticket | Ratio | Level recorded |
|---|---|---|
| opened in the security concern category | architect ratio | architect |
| opened in another category and reprioritized to P1 after opening | senior engineer ratio | senior engineer |
| any other, including one opened at P1 and never reprioritized | technician ratio | technician |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 40-Hour Block (architect ratio 1.5, senior engineer ratio 1.25, technician ratio 1.0) with 120 minutes drawn in business hours: 3.00, 2.50 and 2.00 hours respectively.
